disclaimer.zh: 本报告由 DeepGuard 审计 Agent 自动执行并生成。安全审计存在固有限制：静态分析无法覆盖全部运行时行为，动态观测无法穷尽全部触发路径，AI 语义判断可能存在漏报与误报。本报告的「未检出」结论仅表示在当前规则库版本、检测深度与时间窗口内未发现恶意行为或安全风险，不构成对该插件绝对安全、现在或未来均无恶意行为的任何保证；检出项亦可能因上下文差异存在偏差。本报告仅覆盖所标注的插件版本与 commit 快照，作者此后发布的新版本或对既有版本的任何改写（含 force-push）均不在覆盖范围内。用户安装与使用插件属自主行为，相关风险由用户自行评估与承担。DeepGuard 保留随规则库升级对历史版本重新审计并修订结论的权利。
disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. DeepGuard reserves the right to re-audit historical versions and revise conclusions as the ruleset evolves.

checked_items.zh: 扫描了全部源码与配置，未发现硬编码的密钥、口令、令牌，也未发现读取本机 SSH 私钥、云服务凭据或主目录敏感凭据文件的代码。
checked_items.en: Scanned all source code and configuration; no hardcoded credentials, passwords, or tokens were found, nor any code that reads local SSH private keys, cloud service credentials, or sensitive credential files in the home directory.

checked_items.zh: 插件管理的 cookies.txt 由用户主动上传、存于插件自己的目录，仅在请求同一视频站点域名时按域名匹配转发（不匹配的条目被过滤），未发现把凭据发往第三方地址的路径。
checked_items.en: The cookies.txt managed by the plugin is actively uploaded by the user, stored in the plugin's own directory, and forwarded only by domain matching when requesting the same video site domain (non-matching entries are filtered out). No path that sends credentials to third-party addresses was found.

evidence.zh: 插件只读取用户主动上传的 cookies.txt，并只在请求同一视频站点时按域名转发；未发现系统级凭据读取或凭据外发通道。
evidence.en: The plugin only reads the user-uploaded cookies.txt and forwards it by domain only when requesting the same video site; no system-level credential reading or credential exfiltration channel was found.

checked_items.zh: 插件不注册任何面向模型的工具，也没有系统提示注入调用；全树无工具描述文本、无模型可见的指令文件（技能/代理指令类文档）。
checked_items.en: The plugin registers no model-facing tools and has no system prompt injection calls; the entire tree contains no tool description text and no model-visible instruction files (skill/agent instruction-type documents).

checked_items.zh: README 与界面文案为功能说明与操作指引，未发现要求忽略指令、伪装高权限消息或诱导安装/放权等注入措辞。
checked_items.en: The README and UI copy are functional descriptions and operation instructions; no injection wording requiring ignoring instructions, disguising high-privilege messages, or inducing installation/permission grants was found.

checked_items.zh: 对话推送功能仅把模型推送的视频标题原样显示为界面提示文字，采用纯文本写入，不构成注入载体。
checked_items.en: The conversation push feature only displays the model-pushed video title verbatim as interface prompt text, written as plain text, and does not constitute an injection vector.

evidence.zh: 插件不注册面向模型的工具，没有工具描述或系统提示注入点，无可投毒载体。
evidence.en: The plugin registers no model-facing tools, has no tool descriptions or system prompt injection points, and has no poisoning vector.

evidence.zh: 插件不暴露模型可见的工具描述，不存在可诱导模型执行安装或改配置的措辞面。
evidence.en: The plugin exposes no model-visible tool descriptions, and there is no wording surface that could induce the model to execute installations or change configurations.

evidence.zh: 源码中不存在监听模型每步推导前消息改写事件的代码。
evidence.en: No code listening for model pre-step message-rewriting events exists in the source code.

checked_items.zh: 全树未发现动态执行代码的写法（求值、动态构造函数、虚拟机执行等均未出现）；唯一的进程调用是经系统 API 以参数数组方式启动 yt-dlp/ffmpeg 与只读的挂载列表命令，不经过 shell。
checked_items.en: No dynamic code execution patterns (eval, dynamic constructors, VM execution, etc.) were found in the entire tree; the only process calls launch yt-dlp/ffmpeg via system APIs with argument arrays and a read-only mount-list command, without going through a shell.

checked_items.zh: 机械预扫命中的进程调用导入（规则 DG-R3-55）：用于运行 yt-dlp 拉取列表/解析直链/下载合并和解析挂载点；网址以参数形式传入且先经『必须以 http 开头』校验，未发现可注入 shell 命令或选项的路径，判定为良性用法。
checked_items.en: The process-call import hit by the mechanical pre-scan (rule DG-R3-55) is used to run yt-dlp for fetching lists/resolving direct links/downloading/merging and resolving mount points; URLs are passed as arguments and first validated to start with 'http', with no path for injecting shell commands or options found; determined to be benign usage.

checked_items.zh: 机械预扫命中的两处浏览器端键盘监听（规则 DG-R3-57）：分别为播放窗口的快进/切换/暂停快捷键与地址栏回车确认，只控制本窗口 UI，不读写剪贴板、不调用凭据接口、无外部信标，判定为良性。
checked_items.en: The two browser-side keyboard listeners hit by the mechanical pre-scan (rule DG-R3-57) are respectively the playback window's fast-forward/switch/pause shortcuts and the address-bar Enter confirmation; they only control this window's UI, do not read/write the clipboard, do not call credential interfaces, and have no external beacons; determined to be benign.

checked_items.zh: 挂载配置为纯声明（只插入一行播放器加载条目），不含动态求值标记；包清单无安装/构建钩子。
checked_items.en: The patch config is purely declarative (only inserts one player-loading entry) and contains no dynamic evaluation markers; the package manifest has no install/build hooks.

evidence.zh: 挂载配置是纯声明，只插入一行加载条目，全树 yml 无动态求值标记。
evidence.en: The patch config is purely declarative, only inserting one loading entry, and the entire tree's YAML has no dynamic evaluation markers.

evidence.zh: 源码未调用把模型代码放到虚拟机在宿主运行的那类动态包工具。
evidence.en: The source code does not call the kind of dynamic packaging tool that runs model code in a VM on the host.

evidence.zh: 包清单无安装/构建钩子，树内无执行载体脚本；README 安装示例使用浮动分支引用属用户安装时选择。
evidence.en: The package manifest has no install/build hooks, and there are no executable carrier scripts in the tree; the README install example's use of a floating branch reference is a user choice at install time.

evidence.zh: 包声明了浏览器半边入口；浏览器 bundle 中只有播放器快捷键与输入框回车监听，未发现键盘窃听、剪贴板读取或调用凭据接口的代码，也无指向外部地址的信标。
evidence.en: The package declares a browser-half entry; the browser bundle contains only player shortcut and input-box Enter listeners, with no keylogging, clipboard reading, or credential-interface calls, and no beacons pointing to external addresses.

evidence.zh: 未注册任何子代理提供方。
未使用后台任务、定时提醒、持久目标等常驻机制，也无轮次续命监听。
evidence.en: No background tasks, scheduled reminders, persistent goals, or other resident mechanisms are used, and there are no round-survival listeners.

checked_items.zh: 全树未发现把本地数据编码后发送到固定外部地址的外发链；插件的对外请求全部由用户粘贴的网址或对话推送的网址触发，且仅在用户操作播放时发生。
checked_items.en: No exfiltration chain that encodes local data and sends it to a fixed external address was found in the entire tree; all outbound requests of the plugin are triggered by user-pasted URLs or URLs from conversation pushes, and occur only when the user operates playback.

checked_items.zh: 机械预扫命中的 curl 字样（规则 DG-R4-53）：位于注释中，描述 yt-dlp 的 TLS 指纹伪装能力，源码中没有任何执行 curl/wget 的命令，判定为良性。
checked_items.en: The curl wording hit by the mechanical pre-scan (rule DG-R4-53) is in comments describing yt-dlp's TLS fingerprint spoofing capability; there is no command in the source code that executes curl/wget; determined to be benign.

checked_items.zh: cookies.txt 仅在请求同域视频站点时转发；无固定回传域名、无隧道或带外通道。
checked_items.en: cookies.txt is forwarded only when requesting same-domain video sites; there is no fixed exfiltration domain, no tunnel, and no out-of-band channel.

evidence.zh: 源码中不存在监听模型请求路由事件或注册自定义模型适配器的代码。
evidence.en: No code listening to model request-routing events or registering custom model adapters exists in the source code.

checked_items.zh: 包不依赖任何第三方运行库（无依赖项声明），无安装/构建钩子，纯 JS 无构建产物，供应链篡改面小。
checked_items.en: The package has no third-party runtime dependencies (no dependency declarations), no install/build hooks, is pure JS with no build artifacts, and has a small supply-chain tampering surface.

checked_items.zh: 挂载配置仅插入播放器加载条目，不触碰沙箱/审批/权限配置、未禁用任何安全行、未用环境变量降权、未改写注入/拦截配置（规则 DG-R5-51/52/53 均未命中）。
checked_items.en: The patch config only inserts a player-loading entry, does not touch sandbox/approval/permission configurations, does not disable any security lines, does not lower privileges via environment variables, and does not rewrite injection/interception configurations (rules DG-R5-51/52/53 all not hit).

checked_items.zh: README 安装示例使用浮动分支引用（规则 DG-R5-56 相关）：该命令由用户安装时执行、是否钉 commit 由用户决定，仓库自身无依赖层面的浮动引用，不作风险定级。
checked_items.en: The README install example uses a floating branch reference (rule DG-R5-56 related): the command is executed by the user at install time, whether to pin the commit is the user's decision, and the repository itself has no dependency-level floating reference; not rated as a risk.

checked_items.zh: 作者信息无外部核验记录（规则 DG-R5-57 相关）：仅客观记录，不据此定级。
checked_items.en: The author information has no external verification records (rule DG-R5-57 related): recorded objectively only, not rated on that basis.

evidence.zh: 挂载配置仅插入加载条目，未触碰沙箱/审批/权限配置，未禁用安全行，未用环境变量降权。
evidence.en: The patch config only inserts a loading entry, does not touch sandbox/approval/permission configurations, does not disable security lines, and does not lower privileges via environment variables.

evidence.zh: 插件没有监听审批或工具执行前等安全事件的逻辑，不存在截断审批链的可能。
evidence.en: The plugin has no logic listening to security events such as approvals or pre-tool execution, and there is no possibility of truncating the approval chain.

evidence.zh: 本次为首次审计，无上一版本基线可比较升级自动激活。
evidence.en: This is the first audit; there is no previous-version baseline for comparing upgrade auto-activation.

evidence.zh: 挂载配置未改写注入/拦截配置。
evidence.en: The patch config does not rewrite injection/interception configurations.

checked_items.zh: 插件在宿主的本机 Web 服务上注册 /video-player 前缀路由；该服务本身无认证属宿主固有模型（规则 DG-R6-51 相关），README 已明确『可访问路径 = 本机 shell 可读范围，GUI 默认绑定 127.0.0.1』，属生态固有风险而非本插件引入。
checked_items.en: The plugin registers a /video-player prefixed route on the host's local web service; that service's lack of authentication is an inherent host model (rule DG-R6-51 related), and the README clearly states 'accessible path = local shell readable scope, GUI binds 127.0.0.1 by default', which is an ecosystem-inherent risk rather than one introduced by this plugin.

checked_items.zh: 写入面有自限：cookie 上传有文件名白名单与 5MB 体积上限且只写插件自己的目录；缓存清理只删插件自己的缓存目录；推送队列为纯内存、无文件或网络副作用。
checked_items.en: The write surface is self-limiting: cookie upload has a filename whitelist and a 5MB size limit and only writes to the plugin's own directory; cache cleanup only deletes the plugin's own cache directory; the push queue is purely in-memory with no file or network side effects.

checked_items.zh: 未做动态沙箱验证（无动态产物），运行时行为仅依据静态分析结论。
checked_items.en: No dynamic sandbox verification was performed (no dynamic artifacts); runtime behavior is based solely on static analysis conclusions.

evidence.zh: 插件在宿主本机 Web 服务上注册路由；宿主无认证属生态固有模型，README 已明确本机信任范围并自限写入面。
evidence.en: The plugin registers a route on the host's local web service; the host's lack of authentication is an ecosystem-inherent model, and the README clearly states the local trust scope and self-limits the write surface.

summary.zh: 包清单正确声明插件身份与浏览器半边入口，挂载配置为纯声明插入，无身份仿冒信号；作者信息仅客观记录。
summary.en: The package manifest correctly declares the plugin identity and browser-half entry, the patch config is a purely declarative insertion, with no identity-spoofing signals; author information is recorded objectively only.

summary.zh: 静态规则面全部命中点（键盘监听 2 处、进程调用导入、curl 注释）经逐条核查均为良性用法，未检出恶意代码模式。
summary.en: All static rule hits (2 keyboard listeners, process-call import, curl comment) were verified item by item as benign usage, and no malicious code patterns were detected.

summary.zh: 无安装钩子、无混淆与动态解码载荷、无凭据枚举命令；cookie 仅限用户上传文件且按域名过滤转发。
summary.en: No install hooks, no obfuscation or dynamic decoding payloads, and no credential-enumeration commands; cookies are limited to user-uploaded files and forwarded with domain filtering.

summary.zh: 插件不面向模型暴露任何文本面（无工具描述、系统提示、指令文件），无可投毒载体。
summary.en: The plugin exposes no text surface to the model (no tool descriptions, system prompts, or instruction files), and there is no poisoning vector.

summary.zh: 本阶段未做动态沙箱验证（无动态产物）。
summary.en: No dynamic sandbox verification was performed at this stage (no dynamic artifacts).

limits.zh: L4 动态沙箱未启用（未做动态验证）；仓库无 dsh.plugin.json 能力声明清单，插件能力声明为依据代码实测推断（network/shell 有实调用、fs 可读任意目录并仅写插件自身目录、无模型面），README 安装示例使用浮动分支引用属用户安装选择；package.json 未声明 engines.dsh，兼容条目按审计参照运行时记录为未测试。
limits.en: L4 dynamic sandbox not enabled (no dynamic verification performed); the repository has no dsh.plugin.json capability declaration manifest, so plugin capabilities are inferred from code measurement (network/shell have real calls, fs can read any directory and only writes to the plugin's own directory, no model surface); the README install example's floating branch reference is a user install choice; package.json does not declare engines.dsh, and compatibility entries are recorded as untested against the audit reference runtime.
